title: Dooky Detective media root cleanup
content:
This was a small but useful Dooky Detective maintenance pass to bring the image library layout fully in line with the shared server model before the new video work continues.

What changed:

  • Shared media split: the existing Dooky image groups now live under photos, and a sibling video folder is ready for the next pass.
  • Old local leftovers removed: the stale repo-local files in dookydetective\images were deleted so the project no longer pretends that folder is still the active runtime library.
  • Backend path cleanup: the Dooky API now prefers E:\images\dookydetective and falls back to the shared UNC path on the laptop, matching the current multi-machine setup more honestly.

The point of this pass was clarity: photo and video work are now separated cleanly, and future restarts or handoffs should no longer drift back toward the older local-image assumption.
